meta.title: Price-Trend Dashboard: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Category Manager on the specified Growth-plan tenant and verify that Price-Trend Dashboard is unavailable.
Repeat the same Price-Trend Dashboard workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and compare availability.
The tenant plan entitlement and same-user cross-tenant comparison cannot be established because no tenant IDs or plan-setting step is provided.

steps.note: Open an existing event as the closest available path to the event analytics area.
